events.title: Frozen
events.description: JANUARY 3 - February 7 PERFORMANCE SCHEDULE Smoketown Elementary School 500 Mt Sidney Rd, Lancaster Friday, January 29 • 7pm Saturday, January 30 • 11am & 3pm Sunday, January 31 • 3pm Friday, February 5 • 7pm Saturday, February 6 • 11am & 3pm Sunday, February 7 • 3pm Servant Stage is proud to present an all-teen production of Disney’s Frozen, the full-length Broadway musical based on the beloved animated film, featuring music and lyrics by Kristen Anderson-Lopez and Robert Lopez and a book by Jennifer Lee. This magical and heartfelt musical tells the story of sisters Anna and Elsa, whose deep bond is tested when Elsa’s hidden powers plunge the kingdom of Arendelle into an eternal winter. As Anna sets out on a daring journey to bring her sister home, she encounters the rugged Kristoff, his loyal reindeer Sven, and the delightfully optimistic snowman Olaf. Featuring beloved songs including “Let It Go,” “For the First Time in Forever,” and “Do You Want to Build a Snowman?” alongside new music written for the stage, Frozen is an adventurous and moving story of family, courage, self-acceptance, and the extraordinary power of love. Program & Production Information Teen Productions These shows are full-length musicals for teen performers (ages 13-19). These productions are for experienced students who are ready to engage with material that is lengthier and more complex. Unlike our JR and KIDS productions, where registration takes place before auditions, these productions will be cast fully by auditions, with auditions taking place well in advance of the rehearsal process. Upon receiving casting offers, students will register with tuition following our tiered pricing model. The cast size is slightly smaller than our JR and KIDS cast sizes, allowing for more focused intentional work with the students, a more efficient rehearsal process, and more opportunities for students to take on understudy and swing responsibilities. Similarly to our JR productions this will be a more realised production with a small set, curated props, costumes, and lights to visually support the work of the students. Content Advisory Disney’s Frozen is a full-length stage adaptation of the beloved Disney animated film, featuring the familiar characters, story, and songs alongside additional music written for the stage. Themes of grief and loss, including the death of Anna and Elsa’s parents. Moments of mild peril and violence, including characters being threatened, injured, or placed in life-threatening situations. Some potentially frightening or emotionally intense moments involving Elsa’s magical powers, isolation, and fear.
